2023-4770-4927-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

280-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Golgari Rot Farm's ability by tapping it, adding {B}{G}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

3099-3812-6723.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3099-3812-6723.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3812-6723.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

728-3249-4549-4871--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

792-2738-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1809-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

749-2523-2869.description:
Activate Lena by sacrificing it.
When Lena dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Lena that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Lena ability.
Repeat using the Lena token

4116-5296-5636-5660.easyPrerequisites: There are at least four permanent cards between your hand and graveyard.
4116-5296-5636-5660.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
4116-5296-5636-5660.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Psychic Frog until your next turn.
Activate Volrath using Psychic Frog's ability four times by discarding four cards.
Holding priority, activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Evolution Witness until your next turn.
Resolve the first Volrath ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Volrath triggers, returning a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for each remaining ability.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Workhorse until end of turn.
Activate Volrath using Workhorse's ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3185-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2112-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2112-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hound of Griselbrand.
Hound of Griselbrand dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hound of Griselbrand trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hound of Griselbrand, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

1409-1770-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3330-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

876-1170-1329-3518.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1768-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale and Juniper Order Ranger.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn and Juniper Order Ranger.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

1744-3487-4772-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

654-678-5256-6644.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

759-1247-2348-5963-6549.description:
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

224-2137-3177.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
224-2137-3177.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
224-2137-3177.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
224-2137-3177.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4050-4210-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-4210-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple indestructible.
3490-4050-4210-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

3946-5451-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2018-3532-4050-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have flying.
2018-3532-4050-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature without flying, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the flying counter from the creature sacrificed in step 2.
Repeat.

1799-2579-2701-4050-4125.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding one mana of any color.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Shipwreck Dowser from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

719-1869-2232-2792.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1869-2232-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Great Whale to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

225-539-2922-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic Island, Swamp or Plains in library.
225-539-2922-5077.description:
Play Obscura Storefront.
Obscura Storefront enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Resolve the Obscura Storefront trigger, causing you to sacrifice it, then search your library for a basic Swamp, Plains or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Obscura Storefront from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

3263-5089.description:
Mycosynth Lattice turns all permanents into artifacts.
Activated abilities of permanents your opponent control can not be activated due to Karn, the Great Creator.
